name: Auxiliary-board load-shedding input
summary: Receives the command to disconnect the room loads selected by the load-priority scheme.
description: Receives the command to disconnect the room loads selected by the load-priority scheme. An auxiliary AC distribution diagram identifies the supplies serving room services and control-support equipment. Essential, backed-up and ordinary circuits can have different source paths and operating priorities.

In a switchroom, the lighting, service sockets, charger input and room cooling may be fed from different auxiliary branches. A source change must preserve the identities of loads that require continuity. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Load-shedding command” at the input and “Assigned auxiliary-load disconnection” at the output. The essential-load definition governs exclusions.
